hero.headline: Building Digital Products. Engineering Scalable Systems. Delivering Complete Technology Solutions.
hero.description: Looking for a freelance developer who builds your website or application exactly the way you want it — not from a rigid template? I design and build fully custom websites, web apps, and digital products, backed by the DevOps and cloud infrastructure to actually run them in production.

about.heading: A freelance developer who builds your site exactly how you want it.
about.summary: I work directly with you — no account managers, no rigid packages — to design, build, and ship a website or application that's fully customized to your business, not assembled from a template.
paragraphs: As an independent freelancer, you work with me directly from the first conversation to the final deployment — your requirements shape the build, not a predefined package.

Most freelancers hand off a website and walk away. I treat every engagement as a complete system: properly architected, fully customizable, version-controlled, and built to scale past the first release — with the DevOps and cloud infrastructure to actually keep it running.

Whether it's a custom website, a full web application, or a cloud-hosted production system, my goal is the same — build it exactly the way you need it, and ship something reliable and genuinely production-ready.
highlights: Direct, one-on-one collaboration — you work with me, not a team
Fully custom builds, not templates or rigid packages
End-to-end ownership from architecture to deployment
CI/CD, containers, and cloud platforms as a default, not an afterthought
